result.name: test_run
result.description: Run tests of a workspace. Fast by default on Maven projects: after one Maven prepare per workspace, only changed sources are compiled and the tests run in one JVM (seconds); mode="build" runs the project's Maven/Gradle (the final check). files=[{path, content|edits}] writes before running, so a try is one call. Every result is kept per test, so workspace_patch can show which tests failed before the fix and pass after it (red-green). The answer has: each test, its status and time, failures with message and the code parts to work on (the repo frames of the stack trace with the lines around them), compile errors with their lines, and the output tail. With env + db (or ddl_path), the run gets a throwaway Postgres database loaded with the DDL snapshot, passed to Spring as SPRING_DATASOURCE_*. Shown as a view. Takes a while: if it answers "running", call it again with that job id.

files.description: Write these first (like workspace_write), then run: one call per try

mode.description: fast: compile only what changed and run in one JVM (Maven projects; a few seconds); build: the project's Maven/Gradle (the final check before the patch); auto: fast where it fits

env.description: With db: the environment of the DDL snapshot

db.description: Database to snapshot into the throwaway test database

ddl_path.description: Or: a DDL file in the workspace to load (e.g. src/test/resources/dt-schema/pay.sql)

fixture_path.description: Saved src/test/resources/dt-fixtures/<name>; replay its PG databases on scratch Postgres and expose Kafka files as DT_FIXTURE_PATH

fixture_template.description: Reuse a verified immutable prefilled PostgreSQL template and allocate private leased clones

fixture_bindings.description: For multiple databases: {orders:"SPRING_DATASOURCE",billing:"BILLING_DATASOURCE"}; each prefix gets _URL, _USERNAME, _PASSWORD

allow_incomplete.description: Replay a fixture with reported gaps (review fixture explorer first)

job.description: A job id from an earlier "running" answer

check.description: Compile the written Java files right away

fix.description: Apply the clear compile fixes to the files (false: offer them as suggestions)
